question: Which shipments have a specific status?Answer

candidates.query: MATCH (s:Shipment)<-[:DEPENDS_ON]-(o:Order) WHERE EXISTS((s)-[:HAS_STATUS]->(status:Status {name:'specific_status'})) RETURN DISTINCT s.shipment_id

MATCH (l:Lot)-[:PROCESSED_WITH]->(t:Tool), (p:Product)-[:REQUIRES]->(ls:ProcessStep)-[:USED_IN]->(m:Material) WHERE EXISTS((s:Shipment)<-[:DEPENDS_ON]-(o:Order {order_id:'placeholder_order_id'})) AND EXISTS((s)-[:HAS_STATUS]->(status:Status {name:'specific_status'})) RETURN s.shipment_id

MATCH (c:CapacityConstraint), (f:Fab)-[:PRODUCES]->(p:Product)-[:REQUIRES]->(ps:ProcessStep)-[:USED_IN]->(m:Material) WHERE EXISTS((s:Shipment)<-[:DEPENDS_ON]-(o:Order {order_id:'placeholder_order_id'})) AND EXISTS((s)-[:HAS_STATUS]->(status:Status {name:'specific_status'})) RETURN s.shipment_id
